title: Batch Processing with Parallel Agents
description: When N similar artifacts need the same treatment, do one by hand then send agents for the rest.
earned_from: 5 joint demo agents ran in parallel, each got the pattern from ChainSwing

nodes.label: Do one artifact by hand
nodes.detail: Full treatment: read, identity, materials, trail, markers, capture. This establishes the pattern.

nodes.label: Extract the reusable pattern
nodes.detail: What's the base class? What code is shared? What varies per artifact?

nodes.label: Spawn 4-5 agents in parallel
nodes.detail: Each agent gets: the pattern (from prototype), the specific file path, and clear instructions to Write the complete file.

nodes.label: Verify all agents succeeded
nodes.detail: Run Godot capture on each. Check for parse errors. Fix any that failed.

summary: Do one by hand → extract pattern → spawn 4-5 agents with pattern + specific file → verify all succeeded.
